in_marathi.name: Jaywant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaywant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaywant is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘jaya’ meaning victory and ‘want’ meaning conqueror. This name is used to denote a brave and victorious individual, one who conquers challenges and obstacles in life.
